Turn aggregate quality evidence into a safer human review queue

Help quality and care-coordination teams inspect synthetic measure evidence, organize operational review cohorts, and draft unsent outreach while preserving clinical eligibility and privacy review.

**Why try it:** The demo shows where an AI assistant can reduce review friction without pretending to decide who is eligible, overdue, high risk, or ready for outreach.

## Problem Statement

A regional health organization has large volumes of quality evidence, inconsistent barrier review, manual outreach preparation, and limited shared visibility—but cannot compromise clinical eligibility rules or privacy controls.

## Solution Summary

Microsoft Copilot Studio provides the conversational experience. Dynamics 365 supports governed care-coordination work, and Microsoft Teams routes approved review tasks; the package itself uses aggregate synthetic evidence and sends nothing.

**Blueprint role:** Establishes a governed quality-evidence layer between aggregate source data and human clinical, eligibility, privacy, and outreach decisions.

**Capabilities:** Source-evidence gap analysis; Aggregate cohort review; Unsent outreach draft; Qualitative quality dashboard. See [responsibilities and trust boundaries](2.Architecture.md).

## Business Outcomes

- Makes aggregate source limitations and review queues easier for quality teams to see.
- Supports consistent operational cohorting without substituting an algorithm for clinical risk or eligibility review.
- Speeds outreach drafting while keeping consent, privacy, accessibility, and clinical approval explicit.

Claims are qualitative; synthetic demo figures are not customer results or performance commitments. See the [claims policy](../../solutions/README.md#claims-policy).

## Target Users

| Role | Need |
| --- | --- |
| Quality Manager | Find the largest synthetic evidence-review queue and its limitations without deciding measure eligibility. |
| Care Coordinator | Organize operational review cohorts and prepare unsent, privacy-aware outreach drafts for approval. |
| Clinical Operations Lead | Review qualitative source-completeness signals for quality and clinical validation, not a compliance outcome. |

## In Scope / Out of Scope

### In scope

- Summarize aggregate synthetic measure counts, evidence-review queues and limitations, leading with the largest queue.
- Organize synthetic evidence-review cohorts with barriers and draft handling routes as operational triage only.
- Draft privacy-aware outreach with the eligibility prohibition and approval route; no message is sent.
- Show a qualitative source-completeness dashboard with evidence dates and exact reviewer limitations.

### Out of scope / approval boundary

- No live patient information is requested, retained, inferred or exposed; outputs use minimum-necessary synthetic fields.
- No diagnosis, treatment advice, or eligibility, measure-compliance, medical-necessity or authorization outcome.
- No scheduling, contact, outreach, submission, order, referral, task or record change.
- No clinical risk scoring; cohort ordering is operational triage only.
- No launch of multi-channel outreach campaigns or real-time progress tracking; that advertised claim is excluded.
- No workshop publishing and no reuse of the historical Copilot Studio export, which is marked stale.

## Qualification Checklist

- [ ] Is a Microsoft Copilot Studio target environment, with an approved publisher prefix, available for the care-gap build?
- [ ] Can the delivery team verify Power Platform CLI 2.9.3 or newer and initialize a modern `cli-copilot` project?
- [ ] Has the customer decided which care-coordination, Teams review, quality and clinical source, and outreach seams belong in production?
- [ ] Will every production connection be a dedicated read-only reference with no mutating actions?
- [ ] Are quality reviewers, clinicians and authorized outreach operators named for measure validation, clinical interpretation and outreach?
- [ ] Has privacy review confirmed consent, contact preference, accessibility and minimum-necessary content rules for any production use?
- [ ] Is fresh CG-01 Preview evidence planned on synchronized instructions, with publication held for separate approval?
- [ ] Have governance, telemetry, support and success measures been agreed for production quality review?

## What Actually Goes Wrong

- **stale-cg01-contract:** Saved agents and the historical export predate the CG-01 repair, so the largest-queue answer can name the wrong measure.
- **largest-queue-misroute:** The largest-queue question routes to the dashboard and omits the locked evidence-review wording.
- **queue-as-eligibility:** An evidence-review queue is described as an eligible, overdue or noncompliant population.
- **cohort-as-risk-score:** Cohort ordering is treated as clinical risk scoring.
- **rate-as-performance:** Source-recorded closed rates are read as quality performance or verified compliance.
- **credit-capacity:** Build and test consumption is missed because the agent is unpublished.

See [state and recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery).
